'''Theenu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] and the [[War against Zakuul|ensuing conflict]] with the [[Eternal Empire]]. The [[Eternal Empire conquest|surprise attack]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] on both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Their campaign saw Jedi numbers thin over time, leading to surviving Jedi going underground. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] recruited her to join him on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]],Theenu was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. She would eventually rise to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. At some point prior to her time on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] she would tell fellow [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dazh Ranos]] that " her mind wandered too easily". Theenu would be one of the many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to join Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]] in hiding on Ossus in the aftermath of the [[Eternal Empire conquest|surprise attack]] of the Eternal Empire on both the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TOR" />

Theenu would be on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[3628 BBY]] when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent their forces to eliminate the Jedi stationed on Ossus. Theenu would be injured during the Sith attack on the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] and would ask a Republic spacer to rescue any Jedi that were still in the Library.<ref name="TOR" /> Theenu would survive and be reunited with Master Ranos.

==Behind the scenes==
Theenu first appeared in a [[2018]] update for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. She serves as a Quest Giver for Republic Players assigning the Heroic Mission "Expel The Darkness".<ref name="TOR" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
Her advice to Master Ranos and her survival of the Empire's attack would be revealed in a mail from Ranos if the player completed the story as a Republic aligned individual.
